artworks.title: The Peasant in a Window
artworks.description: A person is shown from the shoulders up, leaning through a window opening with one arm resting on the windowsill. The facial features are shadowed, with deep-set eyes and a serious expression. The person is wearing a hooded garment that covers most of the head and drapes over the shoulders. Wooden beams form the window frame and a closed wooden shutter is visible on one side. There is no visible jewelry, and the background is a dark space that contrasts with the lighter tones of the person's attire and the window’s materials.

artworks.title: A Woman Smoking
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated figure, shown from head to toe, positioned with the upper body leaning slightly forward while resting against a chair. The person has short, textured hair that is dark in shade and wears a headscarf tied at the back. Their face is angled towards the viewer with features that suggest focused attention, though the details are largely composed of shading and line work typical of a sketch. They are dressed in a loose-fitting, long robe or gown that gathers at the waist, extending down to their feet. The figure is holding a small pipe in one hand, with the other resting on their lap. Next to the person is a round table that supports a tankard and a book or piece of paper. In the background, crosshatch shading suggests a simple indoor setting with no distinct details of decor or furnishings.

artworks.title: The Inn
artworks.description: The image shows three people in a dimly lit interior setting. The primary figure is a woman seated in the center of the composition. Her body is shown from head to knee, sitting upright, with her head slightly bowed and turned to the left. She wears a long, flowing dress with ample fabric that folds and gathers around her. Next to her, on her right, is a man standing and bending slightly towards her. To the woman's left is another man, crouching and holding a bowl and a spoon. The scene is set in a rustic room or attic, with visible beams and a dark background. The table in front of them is covered with a cloth and holds a jar and a piece of bread.

artworks.title: The Flirtation of a Young Innkeeper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.7 x 17.2 cm (8 15/16 x 6 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene featuring three people gathered around a makeshift table. The scene captures a rustic and intimate setting, with two central figures seated on low stools or chairs around a barrel used as a table. The table surface holds various items including some cards. The surrounding environment is simple, with a wooden backdrop that includes a cupboard with small items on top and a draped cloth hanging from its open door. The composition is detailed with shading that highlights the textures of the clothing and furniture, giving depth to the scene. The use of line and contrast creates a dynamic interaction between the figures. The lower right of the scene shows some scattered cards on the floor.

artworks.title: Christopher, Margrave of Baden
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man shown from the chest up in profile, facing to the right. He is wearing a hat that appears to be a beret with a decorative emblem on the front. The man's facial features are detailed, with a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, a strong brow, and a homey beard. His clothing consists of a robe or coat with a distinctive collar tied at the front. There are no visible jewelry or handheld objects. The background is plain and unadorned, with a text at the bottom identifying him as "CRISTOFER9 MARCHIO BADENSIS" and the artwork dated 1511 at the top.

artworks.title: Lamentation for Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures with halos, one sitting and one reclining. The scene is rendered in a circular format with intricate line work. The figure on the left is sitting with hands clasped, wearing draped garments, and has a radiant halo surrounding their head. To the right, a reclining figure also with a radiant halo appears to be resting. Behind them are architectural structures and natural formations in the background.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.description: This is a print of horses and people being impacted by a divine presence in the sky. In the upper-left corner of the print, a man with a long beard is depicted among the clouds, with rays of light radiating from this man towards the ground. Below, horses are shown in dynamic poses, their riders reacting to the blinding light from above. Some of the men and horses appear to have fallen to the ground, while others have their heads thrown back or limbs raised up. The scene is detailed, focusing on line work to create textures and expressions. In the background, a small castle or town can be seen on the right.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black and brown
artworks.description: The image includes four figures. In the center, a man with long hair is hanging on a wooden cross, arms outstretched. He has a beard, closed eyes, and wears a crown of thorns, with minimal clothing. To his left, a woman with long hair is kneeling and covering her face. To his right, two figures stand close together - a man with shoulder-length hair and soft facial features, draped in a long garment, and a woman with bowed head wearing flowing garments and a head covering with a halo-like circle. The background shows hills, silhouetted figures, dramatic clouds, a skull and bones on the ground, and a sign reading "INRI" on top of the cross.

artworks.title: Christ on the Pillar
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular figure in a dynamic pose, partially draped with fabric. A winged figure is intertwined with the muscular figure. The setting includes architectural elements and chains, with a crown of thorns on the ground. The drawing features intricate line work to highlight the tension between the two figures.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: This drawing features a crucifixion scene, with a central figure on a cross accompanied by two others. Above the central figure is an INRI inscription, and a group of onlookers gather below the crosses. The background shows a cityscape with buildings and spires, as various individuals and soldiers observe the scene. The drawing is detailed and includes expressive characters and a somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Three Fates: Lachesis, Atropos and Clotho
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in a fantastical woodland setting. The figures are gathered around a tall stick-like structure topped with an object. Two figures appear to be nude with long flowing hair, while the third figure has distinctive headwear. The elder figure reaches towards the object on top of the structure, while another figure crouches nearby. A small child-like figure is depicted at the bottom of the scene. The background includes foliage and a gnarled tree. The drawing is intricate with detailed line work creating textures and depth.

artworks.title: Group of Seven Horses in Woods
artworks.description: This is a drawing of horses in a wooded setting. The artwork features a group of seven horses in various dynamic poses within a forest setting. The horses are intricately detailed, with flowing manes and tails, set against a background of trees and foliage. Shadows and cross-hatching techniques are used to add depth and drama to the classical style drawing.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a crucifixion scene. The central focus is a figure on a cross with an 'INRI' inscription above. Various figures are depicted at the base of the cross engaged in different activities or gestures. Surrounding elements include a flower, a sun with a face, clouds, a crescent moon, and a skull and bones in the foreground. The background features a small building or castle atop a hill. The illustration showcases intricate line work similar to traditional woodcut or engraving techniques.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve
artworks.description: The image shows two nude figures standing side by side in a natural setting. The person on the left has long hair and distinctive facial features, looking downward. The person on the right has curly hair and a beard, with deep-set eyes and a broad nose. Their left arm is around the other person's shoulder, while their right arm holds an object. The left figure holds botanical elements. The background features trees, foliage, a serpent, and animals. Above the figures is a plaque with text, all in a woodcut style.

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person bound to a tree amidst cherubic figures in the clouds. The image has a classical style depicting a dramatic scene where a figure is tied to a tree with arrows piercing the figure, surrounded by what appear to be angels or cherubs. The composition is rich with intricate linework typical of Renaissance engravings, capturing detailed textures in the clouds, landscape, and figures. The background showcases a distant landscape with rolling hills and a small settlement, providing a sense of depth and context to the scene. The skillful use of shading adds to the dimensionality and emotional impact of the imagery.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright. His head is turned slightly to the left, with a furrowed brow and a solemn expression. The man has curly hair with no distinct hairline, and is dressed in a long robe. He holds an open book in his left hand and a staff in his right hand. He is barefoot, with his toes visible at the bottom of his robe. A halo encircles his head. The background is plain, with some foliage near his feet.

artworks.title: Saint Matthew
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing with a contemplative expression. He has a long, flowing beard and short hair, partially bald. He wears long robes down to his feet, where his toes are visible. He holds an open book in his left hand and a staff with a distinctive pointed top in his right hand. A halo surrounds his head. The background is simple with stylized foliage at the bottom corners. Above his left shoulder are initials and the date "1519."

artworks.title: Apostle Judas Thaddeus
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing upright, leaning slightly forward resting their weight on a long staff. The person has facial features with a large bushy beard and curly hair. They wear a long robe and hold an open book in one hand. A glowing halo surrounds their head. The background is simple, with some tufts of grass visible near the person's feet.

artworks.title: Apostle Judas Thaddeus
artworks.description: The image depicts a bearded man with flowing hair standing in a slightly stooped position. The man has detailed facial features with a strong, serious expression, deep-set eyes, and a prominent beard. He is wearing a loose, long robe that covers most of his body, revealing his bare feet. In his left hand, he holds a book, and his right hand holds a long staff resting on the ground. A halo with radiating lines surrounds his head, and the background has simple lines defining the halo effect and ground texture. The initials "I G B" appear to the right of the figure, and the ground beneath his feet is depicted with grass or foliage.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image shows a man holding a long sword with his left hand while holding a book with his right arm. He has long, curly hair and a beard, is barefoot on grass, and is wearing a robe with a cloth over his shoulders. The man has a serene expression, with a halo around his head and rays radiating outwards. The background features radiating lines suggesting illumination. The image is in monochrome with a focus on line and detail.

artworks.title: Saint James the Less
artworks.description: The image shows a standing man in a stylized illustration. The person is standing with one foot slightly forward, holding an object resembling a double-headed sword. His face has a full, curly beard and wild hair. He wears long, flowing robes with intricate folds. Rays emanate from his head, creating a halo effect. Small plants or foliage are near his feet, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Saint Simon
artworks.description: This print shows a man standing with his body facing us and his head turned to the left. He appears to be an elderly man, with a long, white beard and thin hair. His brow is furrowed, and his mouth is slightly open. He is wearing a robe-like garment of draped cloth that covers his body, and he holds a large saw. Rays radiate from the man's head, creating a halo effect. The sky behind him is blank, and the ground he stands on is mostly empty except for a few strands of grass.

artworks.title: Saint Thomas
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing and holding a large staff in his left hand. His right hand is raised, and he is looking upwards. The man has a long beard and mustache, short curly hair, and is wearing a flowing robe. He is barefoot, and there are some plants and rocks near his feet. A halo-like radiance appears behind his head. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.description: The image features a man standing upright. He is an older male with a curly beard and hair. He wears a long robe with a cloak wrapped around his shoulders. His footwear is visible, and he is holding a scroll in both hands. The background consists of stylized lines emanating from behind the figure's head, creating a halo effect. The illustration is rendered in a monochrome woodcut or engraving style with bold outlines and shading.
